(Perisytiharan Orang yang Hidup sebagai Warisan Kebangsaan) 2026.

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF LIVING PERSON AS A NATIONAL HERITAGE)

ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1)

of the National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of Living Person

as a National Heritage) Order 2026.

Declaration of National Heritage

2. The persons named in column (1) of the Schedule are declared as

National Heritage in the fields specified in column (2).
